Review queue — SCHEMA (two label-record fields), NOT tooling; DECIDED-UNBUILT (G21)
review_reason: model_disagreement / hybrid_actor / ambiguous_leaf / cat6_category / polarity_review /
orphan_escalation / context_term (+ low_confidence, family_link — PRODUCTION only)
feeds@resolution → registry / rubric_example / unit_rule_evidence / training_data / definitions
lanes = sort by review_reason (no queue tooling built); same schema serves both phases

span.p:
Orphan triage lane (material_type='orphan'; n_leaves=0; context_quality=partial)
LLM first-pass CLEARS clearly-non-operative → typed exclusion (exclusion_family/subclass; L5d, G2);
ASYMMETRIC — escalate the rest; escalated → enriched w/ retrievable raw text → RE-ENTER L3 standard path
orphan=true carried to the final record (same shape, no parallel pipeline; auditable slice)
RATIFIED rule, lane UNBUILT

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
COUNTING SPINE (consumes L2-L4)
burden-count per candidate + grouping across candidates
PRIMARY count = residence-based (parallel instruments = separate burdens; NO dedup on the spine, G18)
duplicate-family lens = separate enrichment (nullable family_id; uniform/divergent), post-labelling · body↔schedule join (none, G19)
→ headline total + economic FLOOR (economic-only; both/either own line)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Legal-BERT — production classifier (trained from L5 labels; runs full corpus)
PRODUCTION mode: confidence-thresholded review — low_confidence routes to review where disagreement did in training;
rules-layer lanes (unlisted-body / orphan / context-term) + the random audit slice run UNCHANGED through both phases
cannot emit per-section multiplicity → open architecture question (G11); requires usable confidence outputs (G9)
